w00-welcome.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) stands in the open front door of her bright apartment and smiles, one arm opened in welcome toward the right; the back of a guest's dark hair shows at the right edge; the tidy living room behind her is empty.
w00-welcome.note: Usable as the kickoff: Ana's welcome is obvious; the guest's hair at the edge only shows that someone is arriving.

w01-things.observed_description: Ana's bright living and dining room with nobody in it: five red apples on the dining table at the left; a red and a blue backpack on a wooden chair; white sneakers and brown shoes on the floor in front of the chair; a TV on a white cabinet; four books on the grey sofa at the right.
w01-things.note: Usable with one cue change: the shoes stand on the floor in front of the chair, not under the table, so the cue is There are some shoes on the floor. (apples on the table, bags on the chair and books on the sofa are as asked). The apples sit near the left edge but read at 360 px in the full 3:2 scene.

w02-family-arrives.observed_description: Ana's living room: the grandfather (thin white hair, white short-sleeved shirt, brown trousers, wooden cane) stands in front of the big window; the grandmother (white hair, lavender blouse) stands behind the grey sofa, hands on its back; Ana's mother (dark hair tied back, purple blouse) stands near the open front door; Ana's father (short dark hair grey at the sides, grey moustache, green shirt) stands behind the dining table with his hands on two chairs.
w02-family-arrives.note: Usable: each family member stands apart; each cue is true of its person and the family word picks the person (the mother also stands behind the far end of the sofa, so behind the sofa is said only of the grandmother).

w03-hide-and-seek.observed_description: A bright living room with no adults: a boy in a red T-shirt crouches behind the grey sofa, head and hands above its back; a girl in a yellow dress with braids peeks from behind a half-open white door; a white-and-brown rabbit sits on the rug in front of the TV cabinet; a tan dog with a white chest and floppy ears lies on the floor next to a mustard-yellow armchair.
w03-hide-and-seek.note: Usable with one cue change: the dog lies next to the armchair, not behind it, so its cue is Max is next to the chair. The boy, the girl and Coco match their cues.

w04-lamps.observed_description: Evening living room: a glowing floor lamp at the left, a TV showing mountains, a laptop with a black screen on the table, and a second floor lamp small at the far right edge; the window reflects the glow.
w04-lamps.note: REJECTED: the switched-off lamp is small at the right edge and the window reflects more lights, so The lamp isn't on. It's off. is hard to find. Redone as w14 in revision 2.

q01-luis-asks.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, navy T-shirt) stands alone by a light dining table in Ana's living room, turns toward the right and asks with one open hand lifted.

q02-sofia-asks.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, blue blazer over a white blouse) stands in Ana's living room, turns toward the right and asks with one open hand lifted; a blurred edge of the listener's head shows at the right edge.
q02-sofia-asks.note: Usable: the listener at the edge is only a blur, and Sofia's questions are about Ana's grandmother and a painting, not about anyone pictured.

q03-diego-asks.observed_description: Diego (burgundy shirt, beard) asks toward a man in a light-blue shirt who stands half in the frame at the right.
q03-diego-asks.note: REJECTED: Diego asks How often does he play football?, and the man at the edge could be read as the he. Redone as q13 in revision 2.

r01-ana-kitchen.observed_description: Ana stands in her spotless kitchen with a folded yellow cloth in one hand and smiles at the camera; the counters are clean and empty.
r01-ana-kitchen.note: Usable: shows Ana has cleaned the kitchen.

r02-grandmother.observed_description: Ana's grandmother (white hair, about 80, lavender blouse) sits at a light wooden dining table with a glass of water and a plate of salad and smiles at the camera.
r02-grandmother.note: Usable as the answer view about her birthday; nothing in it shows a date.

r03-boy-football.observed_description: The boy from the hide-and-seek scene (short dark hair, red T-shirt) stands in Ana's living room holding a black-and-white football in both hands and smiles.
r03-boy-football.note: Usable: the he of Diego's question, with his football.

r04-grandfather-painting.observed_description: Ana's grandfather (white hair, white short-sleeved shirt, brown trousers, cane) stands in Ana's living room and points proudly at a framed painting of green hills and a lake on the wall.
r04-grandfather-painting.note: Usable: shows the grandfather and his painting; no letters or numbers on it.
